svg.text: I/O board · 3 · EBL 119 interface and front plate
Sheet 3/7 · planning schematic · not yet in KiCad
Replaces the LT 100 on ST1: ON/OFF pulses, 12 V on and mains inputs, front LED and button
EBL ON: pulse ST1.2 (green) to GND, 300 ms, like the LT 100 button
EBL OFF: pulse ST1.1 (yellow) to GND, 300 ms
on above ≈ 6 V: the 2 V the EBL leaves when off reads as off
≈ 8 V with shore power → on (threshold ≈ 4 V)
Front plate: green "12 V on" LED, straight from the EBL wire
Lights whenever the EBL reports 12 V on, even if the ESP32 is not running.
Press: the firmware pulses ON or OFF depending on the "12 V on" input. Works without Wi-Fi, Pi or tablet.
